note: Bamberg County has a zoning ordinance (PDF) and a planning department that administers it, but no zoning district polygon layer is published as a queryable service. The county's GIS offerings are parcel and shapefile downloads for a fee via qPublic and the Tax Assessor. The Bamberg_Features service (Clemson, ArcGIS Online) holds wetlands, sink boundaries, PAD-US and county boundary only. ArcGIS searches for Bamberg zoning returned nothing. The cities of Bamberg and Denmark publish no zoning GIS found on their websites.
